Class Site (C : Category) := { covering_family (u : C) := sigT (Vector.t (∃ uᵢ, uᵢ ~> u)); coverage (u : C) : covering_family u; coverage_condition (u : C) (fs : covering_family u) (v : C) (g : v ~> u) : ∃ hs : covering_family v, ForallT (λ '(vⱼ; hⱼ), ExistsT (λ '(uᵢ; fᵢ), ∃ k : vⱼ ~> uᵢ, fᵢ ∘ k ≈ g ∘ hⱼ) (`2 fs)) (`2 hs) }.

"the inherited [Sheaf] predicate is NOT the textbook unique-gluing condition even for that one family.  Its gluing clause is per-leg (a single section over one [u_i], not a simultaneous matching family), and its compatibility antecedent quantifies over ALL sections of the other leg — instantiating [v := u_i], [g := h := id] and the SAME leg [j := i] makes the antecedent force [x_i ≈ x_j] for every [x_j : X u_i], so the hypothesis is satisfiable only when [X u_i] is a subsingleton, and the condition is vacuous at any covered object with two inequivalent sections."

statement_record.book: For an open cover {U_i} of a space X: a family of continuous f_i : U_i → Y agreeing on all pairwise intersections glues to a unique continuous f on X. Equivalently, for every Y the diagram Top(X,Y) → ∏_i Top(U_i,Y) ⇉ ∏_{i,j} Top(U_i ∩ U_j, Y) (the two arrows being restriction) is an equalizer in Set; equivalently again, X is the colimit in Top of the cover diagram U : J' → Top, where J' has objects ⟨i⟩ and ⟨i,j⟩ with arrows ⟨i,j⟩ → ⟨i⟩, ⟨i,j⟩ → ⟨j⟩, U⟨i⟩ = U_i, U⟨i,j⟩ = U_i ∩ U_j, and the colimiting cocone is the family of inclusions U_i → X.
statement_record.intree: Class Sheaf `{@Site C} (X : Presheaf C Sets) := { restriction : ∀ u : C, ... ∀ xᵢ : X uᵢ, (compatibility antecedent over all v, g, and every other leg) → ∃! x : X u, fmap[X] fᵢ x ≈ xᵢ }, over Class Site (C : Category) := { coverage (u : C) : covering_family u; coverage_condition ... }.
